name: Hot vit lon
summary: Hột vịt lộn is the fertilized duck egg at Con Market’s outdoor counters. The stewed egg with gourd is a different plate, vịt lộn um bầu, on Ngô Gia Tự.
origin: A Con Market snack. The stew with gourd is a different plate.
howToEat: Order the egg at the outdoor counters. The stew with gourd is the other plate, on Ngô Gia Tự.
where: Con Market’s outdoor counters, from about 15:00.
The stewed plate, vịt lộn um bầu, is on Ngô Gia Tự, near Chi Lăng stadium.
